==Description==
'''Sun Bathing''' is an emote that can be obtained at Level 9 of the premium [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] track. It was made by Capra. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though sounds of the recliner landing will be played. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

This emote makes the player lay down on a recliner, sun bathing in it.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|240}} or {{Robux|38}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|1,150}} or {{Robux|396}}. Prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, it had a total cost of {{Robux|460}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|48}} with a total cost of {{Robux|500}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had with a total cost of {{Robux|460}}.
